title: CuGaSe2 photosensitive devices: a study of reliability and photoresponse with defects
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18624-18635

Kavin Malar U, Sneha Aich, Soumyaranjan Routray
CuGaSe2 is the material of choice for future generation photosensitive devices such as solar cells due to its high absorption coefficient and band gap. This material was immediately evaluated to determine its suitability as a photovoltaic material.
